skill.summary: Access AI-powered football match predictions from hergunmac.com. Use when the user asks about football/soccer match predictions, betting tips, match analysis, team statistics, head-to-head data, or upcoming match insights. Covers worldwide leagues with confidence scores, AI reasoning, and historical performance tracking.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release - AI-powered football match predictions from hergunmac.com

Features:
- Daily match predictions with confidence scores (0-100%)
- Multiple prediction types: Match Result, Over/Under, BTTS, Double Chance
- Team statistics, form, injuries, and key players
- Head-to-head historical data
- Turkish-English translations for all UI elements
- Browser navigation guide for automation
